tvShows.name: CID
tvShows.description: India's favourite crime thriller show is back! Abhijeet, Daya and other CID officers, led by ACP Pradyuman, join forces with forensic expert Dr Salunkhe to track down the perpetrators who have committed heinous crimes, using every small clue they can find. 'CID' stars Shivaji Satam, Dayanand Shetty, Aditya Srivastava and Narendra Gupta.
